# Background Color

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Background Color

You can use the background-color property to add a background color.

Consider this webpage:

![Simple HTML Webpage](data:image/png;base64,)

Let's add a gray background color to the <h1> element.

```html
1<h1>Welcome to Programiz!</h1>
2<p>Dive into CSS and start turning boring web pages into something that actually looks good.</p>
3<h2>Why Learn with Us?</h2>
4<ul>
5    <li>Code in your browser.</li>
6    <li>Create real-world projects.</li>
7    <li>Get certified for in-demand skills.</li>
8</ul>
```

```css
1h1 {
2    background-color: gray;
3}
```

Browser Output

![CSS h1 Background Color](data:image/png;base64,)

The above code applies the gray background color to all <h1> elements. The background color of other elements remains unchanged.
